excerpts.author: dimitry8570
excerpts.content:
Ah no. Blockchain and state tests we can't fill for osaka and prague. Because there is no support for blockheader fields and eips.

Only eof test format we can.

excerpts.author: dimitry8570
excerpts.content: The state tests / blockchain must be migrated to .py

excerpts.content: Do you also want to support Prague revision?

excerpts.author: chfast
excerpts.content: Not really, we just need Osaka. We can patch existing JSON by changing Cancun/Prague → Osaka. Migration is also planned. But because EEST uses Osaka for EOF already, your coverage script will not work.

excerpts.author: chfast
excerpts.content: Also, please consider merging https://github.com/ethereum/tests/pull/1404: some tests less to care about.
